newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Refugee influx in Vavuniya after army lifts curbs on entry from north.
LTTE used arms captured from Mullaitivu army base to fight troops at Kilinochchi.
LTTE planning to recapture Kilinochchi from army.
Sri Lanka Moslem Congress politburo to meet again on Thursday to review ties with government after three-hour meeting on Wednesday ended inconclusively.
Police probe to see if LTTE raid on Palliyagodalla police post, in which 21 policemen were killed, was due to negligence; office in charge suspended.
